DIALOG_JOIN_SHORT_CODE.SHORT_ID_TITLE: Enter the session code, or your full code
DIALOG_JOIN_SHORT_CODE.SHORT_ID_DESC: 4 digits to join as a new player (e.g. 0042). Add your number to find your avatar again (e.g. 0042-7) — the facilitator can give it to you.
DIALOG_JOIN_SHORT_CODE.INVALID_FORMAT: Expected format: 4 digits, optionally followed by - and your number. E.g. 0042 or 0042-7
DIALOG_JOIN_SHORT_CODE.UNKNOWN_AVATAR: This session contains no avatar with that number.
DIALOG_JOIN_SHORT_CODE.NEEDS_AVATAR_CODE: This session has already started: you need your full code, with your number (e.g. 0042-7).
